assumptions: The integration will implement retry logic locally before deciding to send a final outcome to Datadog.
Mailchimp's HTTP 429 response includes a Retry-After header with a valid integer or HTTP-date value.
The Datadog Events API endpoint is accessible and accepts a POST request with title, text, and timestamp fields.
The system has network access to both Mailchimp and Datadog endpoints.
Retry backoff strategy starts at 1 second and doubles on each attempt (1s, 2s, 4s) respecting the Retry-After header when present.

sources.title: Webhook retry interval increased | Mailchimp | Developer

notes: The source is conceptual: the connector detects an HTTP 429 response from any prior Mailchimp API call (not shown here). No actual webhook or polling URL is defined by the plan; the connector implements retry logic locally before invoking the Datadog target.
Mailchimp API base URL is used as placeholder; real endpoint depends on the original call that returned 429.
Authentication uses Basic Auth where username can be any string (often 'apikey') and password is the Mailchimp API key.
The connector must extract response.status_code, response.headers['retry-after'], and response.body from the failed Mailchimp call after retries are exhausted.

example.title: Mailchimp API Rate Limit Exceeded
example.text: Final status: 429, Retry-After: 60, Response body: {"type":"https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api-concepts/errors/","title":"TooManyRequests","status":429,"detail":"You have exceeded the limit of 10 simultaneous connections."}

notes: Datadog Events API v2 endpoint requires DD-API-KEY header for authentication.
Only 'change' or 'alert' categories are GA; this event uses default category which may require verification.
Timestamp should be Unix seconds; connector must generate current time if not provided.
Text field contains concatenated details from Mailchimp 429 response after retries.
This represents the retry of the original Mailchimp API call that returned 429.
The actual endpoint URL depends on the initial call that failed; the base URL is used as a placeholder.
Connector must implement exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) and respect Retry-After header if present.
After 3 attempts, if still failing, proceed to Datadog event creation.
No specific endpoint is documented for retry; the same API call is retried with delay.
